find.title: Find it for me
find.lead: Tell us what you need and where it goes. An agent finds it and sends you a quote that covers everything to your door: the item, delivery, duties and fees.
find.signInTitle: Sign in to ask for it
find.signInLead: We send the quote and your order's news by email.
find.fromSearch: We'll start from what we read in your search.
find.whatHint: Brand, model, size, what it's for: whatever you know.
find.phoneHint: For the delivery, and if the agent has a question.
find.fileHint: Of the item, its nameplate or its box.
find.failed: The request didn't go through. Try again.
find.sentLead: An agent is looking for it. You'll get the quote by email and in your account.

freight.title: Freight
freight.lead: Move goods you already have, from one address to another. Send photos or a short video of everything: you get an estimate at once, and an agent sends a firm quote.
freight.files: Photos or a video of all the goods
freight.filesHint: Up to 6 photos, or one video of up to 30 seconds. Show everything that travels.
freight.descriptionHint: “3 boxes of motorbike parts, about 45 kg”: counts and weights help the estimate.
freight.declaredValueHint: Customs duties are worked out on it.
freight.needSomething: Add photos or a video, or describe the goods.
freight.needFiles: Add photos or a video of the goods.
freight.rateLimited: Too many estimates for now. Try again in a few minutes.
freight.failed: This didn't go through. Try again.
freight.signInTitle: Sign in to ask for a quote
freight.signInLead: We send the quote and the shipment's news by email.

estimate.cargoTitle: The goods, as we read them
estimate.includesDuties: Includes collection, transport, delivery, duties and customs clearance.
estimate.dutiesLater: Duties aren't included: they depend on the goods' value, which the agent confirms.
estimate.noPrice: We can't price this route at once: the agent's quote will.
estimate.notAQuote: An estimate, not a quote: an agent checks it and sends the price you'll pay.
estimate.unavailable: Instant estimates aren't available right now: an agent replies with a price.
estimate.failed: We couldn't read the photos this time: an agent replies with a price.
estimate.notGoods: We couldn't see goods in these photos. Add photos of what travels, or describe it.

freightRequest.noQuote: No quote open on this request.
